design.name: 应龙
design.brief: The legendary winged dragon Yinglong, who brings rain and slew Chiyou, as a young Chinese loong companion: a long sinuous serpentine body with jade-green scales, a darker deep-teal back ridge (the dark colour block) and a gold belly, two large feathered eagle-like wings in teal fading to deep blue with storm-blue lightning streaks, deer antlers, a flowing white mane and long whiskers, four small clawed legs, and a glowing pearl held in one front claw. Mighty and proud; shown coiling in the air and roaring with lightning around it. About 2.4 m long.
design.turnaround_pose: with the long body stretched nearly straight and horizontal from head to tail with only a gentle wave, both wings spread fully OUT TO THE SIDES, flat and horizontal, the four legs visible below the body with the claws open and EMPTY: NO pearl, NO orb and nothing held in any claw, head facing forward, mouth closed, the mane and whiskers flowing back; NO lightning or clouds anywhere
design.turnaround_digits: each foot shows four separate claws; the wings, antlers and the tail tip are never cut off by the frame.
modeled: serpentine dragon body with four legs (claws empty)
design.revision: 2026-10-18 用户决定宝珠分离：龙身重出四视图（爪子空着），宝珠单独建模（SM_PetPart_YinglongPearl），挂 pearl 挂点；「杀蚩尤」时宝珠升起召雷
